title: Business development
leads: Nobody. You hold the target list and every site lead that comes in.
where: The Cairo office, and wherever the next site is. Some work is remote
hours: Office days, and site visits. Reachable the same day for a new lead
summary: You find the next site, book the meeting, and hand it to the founders to close.

posting.headline: Business development (new sites and the target list), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. Every hour starts with a site that let us in. You keep the target list, reach the owners, and book the meeting. The founders close the deal.
do: Keep the target list current and ranked by the task categories we need.
Rank each site by its upload path too: its own wireless internet, or a hub.
Reach new sites through people we know. When there is nobody, walk in and ask.
Take every site lead from staff. Answer it in the same week.
Book a meeting with a person who can say yes. Hand it to the founders.
Run the referral program. Track which referred site signed, so the reward is paid.
need: You have opened doors at factories, warehouses, hotels, or farms in Egypt.
Comfortable calling a stranger and walking onto a factory floor.
Careful with a list. Every lead has a status and a next step.
Able to keep a secret. You describe the work without saying who it is for.
plus: You know owners or managers at factories, hotels, warehouses, or construction firms.
You have run a referral or partner program.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
A seat next to the people who run the company.
You open the door. The founders close every deal.
The kinds of places we want are already written down. You fill the list.
posting.apply: Send your name, where you live, a phone number, and the sites you have opened. We call back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Business development at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, the Chief of Staff.
Your start date is {start}. In your first weeks you take over the target list from {manager}, rank it, and book your first site meeting.

terms.v: Office days, and site visits. Reachable the same day for a new lead

conditions: A copy of your national ID.
Your signature on the rules, the consent form, and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
expect: You never say the client's name to a site. You say an AI project.
You never promise a site a price or a term. The founders close every deal.
Every lead gets an answer in the same week.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays for accepted hours and wants a mix of task categories, not only a total. Every hour starts with a site that let us in. You find that site, book the meeting, and hand it to Adham and Youssif to close.
outcomes: The target list is ranked and current, with a next step on every line.
Every site lead from staff gets an answer in the same week.
Adham and Youssif walk into a booked meeting with a person who can say yes.
daily: Morning. Take every new lead: the business, the work there, the person known there.
Same day. Add each lead to the list with a rank and a next step.
Every day. Call or visit the top sites. Write down what they said.
Every day. Tell Mano where each lead stands before he meets Adham and Moharam.
Meeting booked. Send Adham and Youssif the work, the person, and the upload path.
weekly: Once a week. Rank the list again with Mano by what the client needs now.
Once a week. Check each top site's upload path: wireless internet or a hub.
Once a week. Chase every lead with no answer. Close the ones that said no.
monthly: Month end. Tell Ahmed Alaa which referred sites signed. He pays the referral reward.
Month end. Count meetings booked and sites signed. Go through the list with Mano.
standards: A site that adds a task category we are short of goes higher.
A site with fast wireless internet, or near a hub with room, goes higher.
You book the meeting. Adham and Youssif close. Never promise a price or a term.
If a site asks who the footage is for, say an AI project.
Anyone can refer a site. The reward is paid when the contract is signed.
never: Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.
Never share prices, volumes, or contract terms with a site.
Never sign or promise anything for the company. The founders close.

firstMonth.what: Take over the target list from Mano. Learn the categories and the upload paths.
Rank the list. Answer every open lead. Contact one site.
Book your first meeting. Brief Adham and Youssif.
Every line has a next step. Mano signs you off.

measures: Meetings booked with a person who can say yes, each month.
Sites signed from your meetings, and the task categories they add.
Leads answered in the same week. Zero left waiting.
Lines with no next step. The good number is zero.
handbook.call: Mano for everything. Adham for the negotiation and the client. Moharam for a site that is already live. Ahmed Alaa for referral rewards.
